title: Remove Counter-balance (CB) Weights From OptiSweep Tipper Carriage
summary: Use a two-person, LOTO-protected mechanical procedure to remove the counter-balance (CB) weight assembly from the OptiSweep tipper carriage by removing four M10 socket head screws while supporting the ~20 kg weights during the final fastener removal, then allow the carriage/gripper to drift to the lower hard stop.
when_to_use: When you need to remove the OptiSweep tipper counter-balance (CB) weight assembly (CB weights) from the tipper carriage using the documented LOTO and fastener removal steps.
roles_and_responsibilities: Two people are required for this procedure.
safety_notes: LOTO the tipper before removing the CB weights.
Support the CB weights during removal of the 4th (last) fastener to prevent dropping.
CB weights are about 20 kg (44 lb) total.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical floor access to the OptiSweep tipper carriage
LOTO capability for the tipper (manual reference: "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2)

system_preconditions: Tipper is LOTO-protected before fastener removal.
external_references: Manual reference: "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" (page 2) (referenced by the CB weights removal procedure).

visual_references.description: Figure 7-4: Counterbalance Weight assembly showing the four M10 socket head screws, lock washers, and counterbalance plates on the OptiSweep tipper carriage.

steps.title: Confirm two-person setup and required PPE/tools
steps.purpose: Ensure the required two-person support and correct tools/PPE are available before starting LOTO and fastener removal.
steps.instruction: Before approaching the OptiSweep tipper carriage, confirm you have two people available and the required PPE/tools: safety glasses, gloves; 16-mm hex wrench; 3/8-in. wrench/socket; and the replacement part CB weights.
steps.expected_result: Two people are available and the required PPE/tools are ready for use at the tipper carriage.
steps.healthy_condition: You can proceed to LOTO and fastener removal without needing to stop to find PPE/tools.
steps.failure_condition: You do not have two people available or any required PPE/tool/part is missing.

actions.label: Verify two-person and tool readiness
actions.exact_action: Confirm you have two people available and the required PPE/tools: safety glasses, gloves; 16-mm hex wrench; 3/8-in. wrench/socket; replacement part CB weights.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if you cannot maintain the required two-person setup for the procedure.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: NOTE: Two (2) people are required for this procedure. Required Tools: 16-mm hex wrench, 3/8-in. wrench/socket. PPE: Safety glasses, gloves.

steps.title: LOTO the tipper
steps.purpose: De-energize and secure the tipper station for safe mechanical work.
steps.instruction: LOTO the tipper using the manual reference "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" (page 2).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is LOTO-protected prior to removing the CB weight fasteners.
steps.healthy_condition: You have completed the LOTO step and are ready to remove the CB weight fasteners.
steps.failure_condition: You attempt to remove CB weight fasteners without completing LOTO.

actions.label: Apply LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if LOTO is not completed before fastener removal.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 1. LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

steps.title: Remove top and/or bottom side guarding if necessary
steps.purpose: Provide access to the CB weights and their mounting fasteners.
steps.instruction: Remove the top and/or bottom side guarding, if necessary, to access the CB weights.
steps.expected_result: CB weights mounting area is accessible for locating and removing the four M10 socket head screws.
steps.healthy_condition: You can clearly access the CB weights and fasteners without obstruction.
steps.failure_condition: Guarding remains in place such that the CB weight fasteners cannot be accessed safely.

actions.label: Remove guarding as needed
actions.exact_action: Remove the top and/or bottom side guarding, if necessary.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if you cannot access the CB weight fasteners safely.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 2. Remove the top and/or bottom side guarding, if necessary.

steps.title: Locate the four M10 socket head screws holding the CB weights
steps.purpose: Identify the exact fasteners to remove the CB weight assembly.
steps.instruction: Locate the four (4) M10 socket head screws holding the CB weights in place (including lock washers and counterbalance plates as shown in Figure 7-4).
steps.expected_result: All four M10 socket head screws are identified and reachable for removal.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the four M10 socket head screws and associated lock washers on the CB weight assembly.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot identify all four M10 socket head screws or access them for removal.

actions.label: Identify CB weight fasteners
actions.exact_action: Locate the four (4) M10 socket head screws holding the CB weights in place.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop if you cannot locate all four M10 socket head screws.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 3. Remove the four (4) M10 socket head screws holding the CB weights in place.
Figure 7-4: Counterbalance Weight shows the four M10 socket head screws and lock washers.

steps.title: Remove the four M10 socket head screws while supporting the weights during the 4th fastener removal
steps.purpose: Safely detach the CB weights without dropping them.
steps.instruction: Remove the four (4) M10 socket head screws holding the CB weights in place. As you remove the 4th (last) fastener, hold the weights so they do not fall. The weights are about 20 kg (44 lb) total.
steps.expected_result: The CB weights are removed without dropping during removal of the 4th (last) fastener.
steps.healthy_condition: During the final fastener removal, the weights remain securely supported by the two-person team and do not fall.
steps.failure_condition: The CB weights are not securely supported during the 4th fastener removal (risk of dropping).

actions.label: Remove M10 fasteners
actions.exact_action: Remove the four (4) M10 socket head screws holding the CB weights in place.

actions.label: Support weights during final fastener removal
actions.exact_action: As the 4th fastener is removed, hold the weights so they do not fall.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the CB weights cannot be securely supported during removal of the 4th fastener (risk of dropping).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 3. Remove the four (4) M10 socket head screws holding the CB weights in place. As the 4th fastener is removed, hold the weights so they do not fall. The weights are about 20 kg (44 lb) total.

steps.title: Observe carriage movement after CB weights removal (drift to lower hard stop)
steps.purpose: Confirm the expected post-removal mechanical behavior.
steps.instruction: After the weights are removed, observe the carriage movement. Movement is acceptable because the gripper will drift to the lower hard stop.
steps.expected_result: After CB weights removal, the carriage/gripper drifts to the lower hard stop.
steps.healthy_condition: Carriage movement occurs and the gripper drifts to the lower hard stop as expected.
steps.failure_condition: The carriage/gripper does not drift to the lower hard stop after the weights are removed.

actions.label: Visual observation of drift
actions.exact_action: Observe the carriage movement: movement is acceptable as the gripper will drift to the lower hard stop.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the carriage/gripper does not drift to the lower hard stop after the weights are removed.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: 4. Once the weights are removed, the carriage may begin to move. The movement is acceptable as the gripper will drift to the lower hard stop.

success_criteria: CB weights are removed without dropping during the 4th fastener removal.
After removal, the carriage/gripper drifts to the lower hard stop.
healthy_conditions: CB weights remain supported during removal of the 4th (last) fastener.
After weights removal, carriage movement occurs and the gripper drifts to the lower hard stop.
failure_conditions: CB weights cannot be securely supported during removal of the 4th fastener (risk of dropping).
Carriage/gripper does not drift to the lower hard stop after weights are removed.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if the CB weights cannot be securely supported during removal of the 4th fastener (risk of dropping).
Stop and escalate if the carriage/gripper does not drift to the lower hard stop after the weights are removed.
